sn12.33:1.2: viharati … catucattāḷīsaṃ vo bhikkhave ñāṇavatthūni desessāmi
sn12.33:1.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn12.33:2.2: jarāmaraṇe ñāṇaṃ jarāmaraṇasamudaye ñāṇaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhe ñāṇaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ
sn12.33:2.3: jātiyā ñāṇaṃ jātisamudaye ñāṇaṃ jātinirodhe ñāṇaṃ jātinirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ
sn12.33:2.4: bhave ñāṇaṃ bhavasamudaye ñāṇaṃ bhavanirodhe ñāṇaṃ bhavanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ
sn12.33:2.5: upādāne ñāṇaṃ upādāna- samudaye ñāṇaṃ upādānanirodhe ñāṇaṃ upādānanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ
sn12.33:2.6: taṇhāya ñāṇaṃ taṇhāsamudaye ñāṇaṃ taṇhānirodhe ñāṇaṃ taṇhānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ
sn12.33:2.7: vedanāya ñāṇaṃ vedanāsamudaye ñāṇaṃ vedanānirodhe ñāṇaṃ vedanānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ
sn12.33:2.12: saṅkhāresu ñāṇaṃ saṅkhārasamudaye ñāṇaṃ saṅkhāranirodhe ñāṇaṃ saṅkhāranirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ
sn12.33:3.2: yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko
sn12.33:3.4: yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccu maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo kaḷevarassa nikkhepo jīvitindriyassa upacchedo
sn12.33:4.3: ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminī paṭipadā seyyathīdaṃ
sn12.33:5.1: yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako evaṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ pajānāti evaṃ jarāmaraṇasamudayaṃ pajānāti evaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhaṃ pajānāti evaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānāti idamassa dhamme ñāṇaṃ.
sn12.33:5.2: so iminā dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atītānāgate nayaṃ neti.
sn12.33:6.1: ye kho keci atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā jarāmaraṇaṃ abbhaññaṃsu jarāmaraṇasamudayaṃ abbhaññaṃsu jarāmaraṇanirodhaṃ abbhaññaṃsu jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abbhaññaṃsu sabbe te evameva abbhaññaṃsu seyyathāpihaṃ etarahi.
sn12.33:7.1: yepi hi keci anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā jarāmaraṇaṃ abhijānissanti jarāmaraṇasamudayaṃ abhijānissanti jarāmaraṇanirodhaṃ abhijānissanti jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhijānissanti sabbe te evameva abhijānissanti seyyathāpihaṃ etarahīti.
sn12.33:8.1: yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imāni dve ñāṇāni parisuddhāni honti pariyodātāni
sn12.33:8.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyasāvako diṭṭhisampanno itipi dassanasampanno itipi āgato imaṃ saddhammaṃ itipi passati imaṃ saddhammaṃ itipi sekkhena ñāṇena samannāgato itipi sekkhāya vijjāya samannāgato itipi dhammasotaṃ samāpanno itipi ariyo nibbedhikapañño itipi amatadvāraṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati itipīti.
